experiment_data.hypothesis: RSFT→bf16 GRPO two-stage: starting from RSFT best checkpoint (s43, rel_f1=0.46), short-range GRPO (50 steps, lr=1e-6) with CED-only reward should further improve evidence quality (EDCR) while preserving rel_f1, because RSFT provides stable base preventing catastrophic forgetting seen in SFT→GRPO.
